notes: Ethereum mainnet (chain 1). LaunchToken has no constructor arguments. BegVault constructor arguments are token, team beneficiary, Intake, IMD fee token, oracle signer, and attempt price in wei. $owner receives the team share and has no administrative powers. BegVault has no owner, setters, pause or upgradeability. The factory sends 80% of the launch supply directly to BegVault and 10% to the pool. Intake, IMD and signer addresses match the accepted README deployment table dated 2026-10-10; live endpoint verification is not claimed. Attempts cost 0.005 ETH. Intake requests use bytes32[] scores and require separate IMD donations through fundOracle(uint256); oracleTokenBudget reports IMD while oracleBudget holds ETH for revealer bounties, with no conversion between assets. Graded escrow is split 80% to jackpotBank, 10% to the ETH oracle budget and 10% to the team as claim credits. Payouts and refunds use pull claims. The accepted implementation uses block-based randomness and allows rearming missed reveal windows. Its automatic-closing twentieth attempt exceeds the 250k gas target; messages must be valid UTF-8 and fit the bounded JSON request budget. No initialization calls are required.
